meta.description: Persistent knowledge log for the NBT ballet automation system. The hourly agent reads this file every run and appends what it learns. Never delete entries — mark them superseded instead.

casting_status_rules.description: How to tell provisional from final casting
signals_provisional: Email body says 'This is not a Performance Casting list'
PDF header says 'Subject to change' with no performance dates listed
Casting sheet has no specific performance date or show number attached
More than ~8 dancers listed per role (suggests learning pool, not final cast)
signals_final: PDF lists specific show dates or show numbers (e.g. 'Show 1', 'Friday May 2')
Casting columns labeled Cast A / Cast B / Cast C with specific dates
Brooke's email body says 'attached is the casting' or 'final casting'
casting_status_rules.when_final_arrives: Compare against the existing provisional entry for the same production. Identify any roles Zach gained or lost. Send a notification with the diff. Update the production entry with status=final and record the change history.

schedule_patterns.description: Observed patterns about how Brooke sends schedules. Updated by the agent as it learns.
observations: Schedules usually arrive the evening before (e.g. Thursday night for Friday's schedule)
Subject format is typically '{Weekday} {M/D} Artist Daily Schedule'
Revised schedules have 'Revised' prepended to the subject — they supersede the earlier version for that date
Wardrobe Fittings section is often present but empty — treat as informational, skip if no cast listed
BREAK rows appear in the table but are not real events
Company Class (9:30am most days) uses 'Kaiser/Clark' as staff
H&G rehearsals primarily use 'Schultz/Baker' as staff
Performance day schedules come from TSC (The Smith Center) and have a different venue

call_logic_notes.description: Hard-won logic for determining if Zach is called to a rehearsal. Update this if Zach reports a mistake.
rules: CRITICAL: "All Dancers as called" has TWO meanings depending on the What column:
TYPE 1 - SPECIFIC ROLE REHEARSAL: What column lists specific role names (e.g. Mother, Father). Only dancers cast in those exact roles come. If Zach is NOT in those roles → NOT_CALLED.

TYPE 2 - FULL RUN-THROUGH: What column references a full act/scene run (e.g. Act 1 & 2 Cast C). Everyone in the production comes. Dancers in the named cast perform, everyone else watches/covers. If Zach is in the production → CALLED.
ALL MEN / ALL MALE ARTISTS: Zach is male → CALLED
ALL WOMEN / ALL FEMALE ARTISTS: NOT_CALLED (Zach is male)
ALL DANCERS (not "as called"): CALLED — everyone comes
APPRENTICES mentioned: CALLED (Zach is an Apprentice)
NBT II only (no Apprentice mention): NOT_CALLED — Zach is not NBT II
COMPANY DANCERS alone (no Apprentice): MAYBE — Zach is Apprentice rank, not Company
COMPANY CLASS with empty Cast: MAYBE unless Apprentices explicitly mentioned
ENSEMBLE CAST AND COVERS / FULL CAST AND COVERS: CALLED (Zach is a cover)
Zach name explicitly in Cast column: CALLED
Specific dancer names listed, Zach not among them: NOT_CALLED
No cast info at all: MAYBE
known_edge_cases: Fairy Cavaliers ≠ Fairy King — these are different roles, do not conflate them
The Transformed Witch ≠ Ice Cream Witch — these are different roles in H&G
When Cast A/B/C is specified in a run-through, Zach attends if he is in ANY cast or is a cover
When "selected NBT II" is mentioned for Company Class, Zach as Apprentice is ambiguous → MAYBE
Wardrobe Fittings section is often empty — skip if no cast is listed
